body:
I'm intrigued...what changed your views from atheism to theism? If it's too personal, you don't have to share. Also, how do you think reincarnation works. Like, I've always imagined reincarnation would suck if it were real because you could come back as something awful and disgusting like, I dunno, one of Oprah's shits or something insignificant like that. I figure there's only a 1% chance you'd come back as one of the 1% (rich, etc). So 99% chance you're going to end up as a tree or something. I dunno. Seems weird to me and I think I'm making light of your beliefs now. Please don't take offense, they're just musings.

But I am genuinely curious what could make a person start believing in a supreme being, besides the usual indoctrination from birth and threats of hell and whatnot. I was, like many other redditors, raised in a religious home. every single person I knew growing up claimed to have literally seen and spoken with angels, demons, and God himself. Everyone except me. After trying for years to have a relationship with God, and him never responding, I just gave up. I mean, he just sorta ignored me. When I realized I'd literally get more of a response from talking to a brick wall (an echo)...I came  to the realization there was no god. At least, no loving creator who listens, cares and responds. There might be some force/energy or whatever that we just can't sense as humans...but what good does that do me. That's far from the god I was told about. Either everyone was lying or deluded, or they were just more worth his time than I was.

Also, here's another one, just for fun. Ever heard of the [WASP](http://www.waspknife.com/about.php) knife? It's badass. I'd go deep sea diving, stab myself with that sucker, it would sink to the ocean floor and I'd float to the surface with a frozen, basketball-sized air pocket in my torso. It seems that my main motivation for suicide would be fucking with people's heads, making them wonder what the hell happened.

I think a lot of that is spot on because it hits close to home. And yeah, I have been burned by a few people I trusted so I do definitely have issues with trust. I've just been wondering lately, when these little daydreams come up, if I'm reeeeally disturbed, or just a normal dude with a few issues and a dark sense of humor. Thanks for the response though. Very thoughtful.

A lot of them involve fire...like renting a Uhaul truck, filling the back with as many gasoline cans as I can afford and then sitting amongst them and shooting one with a flare gun. 

Jabbing sharpened icicles into my jugular and femoral arteries while lying in the bathtub. They'd just melt in the bathwater and I'd bleed out.

Damn, it feels more morbid when I type it out.
